answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the mesa hash is checked against the ivory checkpoint at intake, the garden audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 11 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
